card.name: Bowl Dance
card.era: traced to Yuan dynasty folk dance
card.tagline: Mongolian women dancing while balancing stacked bowls
card.profile: The Mongolian Bowl Dance (頂碗舞, ding wan wu) is a female folk dance of Inner Mongolia in which dancers balance bowls (often of milk tea) on the head while dancing with billowing arm movements, snapping wrists and shoulder shakes (Shen Yun; China Culture). It descends from Yuan-dynasty folk dance traditions and represents a ceremonial offering of milk tea to heaven, homeland and guests (HKU CCCH project; Shen Yun).
card.insight: The dance embodies Mongolian pastoral hospitality and the steppe aesthetic of strong shoulder and wrist work, and is one of the best-known female dances of Inner Mongolia (China Culture, China Daily).
